Sensory: bland, clean dairy flavour, free of scorched or oxidised notes; colour cream to light cream; powder free flowing with no lumps that do not break under light pressure. Sieve: 95% through a US 30 mesh screen.
This specification defines acceptance limits only. It does not report analytical results, and no lot may be released against it without the corresponding certificate of analysis. Shelf life is 24 months from manufacture when stored below 27°C at less than 65% RH. This document does not itself expire; it is reissued on revision.
